prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Californium (Cf) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a chemistry laboratory with a long worktable of glass flasks, a fume hood and shelves of labelled reagent bottles
Time of day: an overcast day — soft, shadowless grey-white light; soft even light, colours calm, no hard shadows.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: a short white lab coat worn open over a cropped knit top and a pencil mini skirt; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 80-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 60-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque; styled with delicate drop earrings; right now — strong light from behind passes through the thin outer fabric, so the outline of her figure shows as a soft silhouette inside it; the inner layer stays fully opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body in side profile, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; head turned back over her shoulder; camera at her eye level; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her; she is seen through window glass with faint reflections on it.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a tiny sealed silver capsule no bigger than a fingertip, resting on a nugget of raw gold up beside her face; it is all she holds.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: one brow raised higher, eyes wide and attentive, lips slightly parted.

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — californium: a silvery synthetic metal first made in 1950 by striking curium with alpha particles, and named for the golden western land and university where she was born, a land itself named after a legendary island of gold at the western edge of the world, ruled by a queen of warrior women armed in gold; one of her forms splits apart on its own, so a single microgram pours out over two million neutrons every second, an invisible spray used to kindle new nuclear reactors, to find hidden veins of gold and silver and pockets of oil deep underground, to spot concealed explosives and to fight cancer, and a single gram of her is worth tens of millions — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.

observations: 가운을 입은 실험실 상반신으로, 손에 든 작은 금빛 소품을 얼굴 옆으로 들어 올린다.
qa.cause: 실험 가운 가슴에 참조의 Cf 문장이 반복된다.
